notes: Both 'a pure heart' and 'a good conscience' put the supplied indefinite on the noun under rule 58, discontinuously under rule 15; the adjective's position before or after the noun makes no difference.
s004 takes 'of the' as one unit on the article under rule 21, leaving parangelias bare.
s006 estin is an expressed copula, so rules 53 and 63 are not in question anywhere in this verse.
